pr_title: roachtest: disable rangefeed buffered sender in mvt
pr_body:
Recently, metamorphic rangefeed buffered senders were enabled, gated behind the crdb_test binary. However, mixed version tests upload their own binary so we must opt them out.

Fixes: #141478
Fixes: #141470
Fixes: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/141494
Fixes: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/141476
FIxes: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/141466
Fixes: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/141470
Fixes: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/141471
Fixes: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/141475
Fixes: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/141465

review_comments: Or maybe we should make a `registry.BufferedSender` test spec to let tests opt out. Can't think of any other tests besides mixed version that would run into any issues though.
This will help clear the backlog of failures, but I'm also a bit concerned that things like these are hidden in `test_runner` rather than visible somewhere on a test spec or metamorphic framework.

If this continues to be a problem, I can speak with the team and see if we can lift the restriction on cluster setting `RangefeedUseBufferedSender` - to not be guarded behind `buildutil.CrdbTestBuild`.
I think we can remove that restriction on master for sure.  That was added during development since some of the code was landing before branch cut but some was landing after branch cut.
Put up https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/141595.
